items.title: Delfeayo Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Kenny was at the tail end of the other band.

ctx.x: But you’re all about the same age – generation.

It was a strange – Kenny was at the tail end of the other band. The situation was not really that hip, actually. Like I said, the way that I came into that particular band was – it wasn’t as natural – you know what I mean? – as when I played with Elvin. But playing with Elvin, I sat in at a gig with Elvin, and he was like – he called me up, said, “Come join the band.” I said, “Whoa, okay.”

That was a very long tenure. We’re going to take that up. We have to change tape here, but of course, Elvin, six or seven years with Elvin, that’s an accomplishment in itself. So we’ll change the tape and we’ll pick it up right there.
